The Vault v0.6.6 fixes two gaps found while checking v0.6.5 against a live install.

## Fixes

- **Graphify multiple-checkouts warning.** v0.6.5 warned when a source folder held several separate projects, but only looked for a `.git` or `package.json` directly inside each subfolder. Zip extracts usually add a wrapper folder (`repo-main/repo-main/package.json`), so a git clone next to an extracted archive went unnoticed and every graph node was duplicated. The check now also looks one level deeper.
- **Source app for Claude desktop saves.** The Claude desktop app connects custom MCP servers through a client named `custom3p-main`, so v0.6.5 recorded its saves as `other`. They are now recorded as `claude`. The `vault_save_memory` response also returns the recorded `source_app` and the raw `mcp_client` name, so a wrong label is visible straight away.

## Verification

- Full automated suite: 57 test files, 410 tests.
- Core, CLI, MCP server, and desktop type checks pass.

This build packages the desktop app and the bundled `vault-memory` MCP sidecar runtime. After installing, open The Vault and use Settings -> Client setup to connect Codex, Claude Desktop, or Claude Code.
